Class Board

java.lang.Object
Board
public class Board extends Object
Represents game board for Clue. The game board creates and contains all tiles that make up walkways, doorways, secret passages, and rooms. It handles movement logic for players throughout all of these possible player positions.

    • getValidMoves

      public ArrayList<Tile> getValidMoves(Player player, int roll)
      Stores all possible destinations tiles and rooms. Also adds secret passages to possible moves to take.
      Parameters:
      player - (player involved in current turn)
      roll - (result of current player's dice roll)
      Returns:
      (returns ArrayList of all possible destination positions)

    • findMoves

      private void findMoves(int row, int col, int stepsLeft, boolean[][] visited)
      Recursive algorithm to find all vallid walkway and room destinations. Adds these locations to the ArrayList validMoves.
      Parameters:
      row - (row of player's current position)
      col - (col of player's current position)
      stepsLeft - (initialized to player's dice roll, decrements as steps are taken to find possible movement paths)
      visited - (2D Array that tracks if the player has visited a tile during recursion)

    • setPlayer

      public void setPlayer(Player player, int r, int c)
      Moves player to specified board position. Gets row and col inputs from UI decisions. If tile is occupied, player cannot be set there. If destination is room, places player into an available designated player spot.
      Parameters:
      player - (player to move)
      r - (row to move player to)
      c - (col to move player to)
